body:
Angry Streak – PvP Killstreak Plugin

🔥 Premium PvP Killstreak Tracking Plugin 🔥

Turn your Minecraft server into an intense PvP battleground with Angry Streak!
Track every kill, celebrate achievements, and dominate the competition with stunning visual feedback.

✨ Key Features

🎯 Killstreak Tracking

Tracks consecutive kills without dying

Announces every streak starting from 5 kills

Broadcasts achievements server-wide

Records personal best streaks

📊 Comprehensive Statistics

Kill count tracking

Death count monitoring

K/D ratio calculation

Current streak display

Best streak records

💬 Premium Messaging System

Bold & colorful announcements

Custom emoji integration

Clean formatting

⚔️ PvP-Focused Gameplay

Only PvP kills count toward streaks

Instant streak reset on death

Motivational announcements

Clean, distraction-free experience

🎮 How It Works

Killstreak System:

Player kills another player → Streak increases

At 5+ kills → Server announcement

Every subsequent kill → New announcement

Player dies → Streak resets, loss announced

Example Gameplay:
⚡ Steve has reached a 5 kill streak! ⚔️💥
⚡ Steve has reached a 6 kill streak! ⚔️💥
💀 Steve has lost a 6 kill streak! ☠️💥

🛠️ Commands & Permissions

Player Commands

/angrystreak – View your statistics

/angrystreak stats [player] – View another player’s stats

/as – Alias

/streak – Alias

Admin Commands

/angrystreak reload – Reload config

Permissions

angrystreak.use – Basic usage (default: true)

angrystreak.admin – Admin commands (default: op)

⚙️ Technical Specifications

Server Compatibility: Paper 1.20.1+

Java Requirement: Java 17+

Performance: Lightweight, file-based storage, minimal impact

Data: YAML configs, backups, persistent player data

📈 Perfect For

Factions

PvP Arenas

Survival PvP

Tournaments & Clan battles

🔧 Installation

Download angry-streak-1.0.0.jar

Place it in your plugins/ folder

Restart server

Customize config.yml

✅ No dependencies required!

📝 Config Options

Minimum streak for announcements

Custom milestone values

Message formatting

Color schemes

Emoji support

🏆 Why Choose Angry Streak?

✨ Premium Quality – Reliable, polished, and updated
🚀 Easy to Use – Simple install and setup
⚡ Performance Focused – Lightweight & efficient
🎯 PvP Optimized – Designed for competitive servers
